site_description: Working through Godot tasks, one GIF at a time.

tasks.title: Add TileMapLayer
tasks.description: Getting started by adding a 2D Scene root node and a TileMapLayer node to create the level. Call the root node 'Level1' and the TileMapLayer 'Ground'

tasks.title: Add a Tileset
tasks.description: Add a Tileset resource for the TileMapLayer. Note: you first need to have downloaded your tileset image.

tasks.title: Add Physics to Tileset
tasks.description: Add collision properties to the Tileset so that players don't fall through your blocks

tasks.title: Painting the Level
tasks.description: Using the TileMapLayer's painting tools to create a level.

tasks.title: Adding a Test Character
tasks.description: Adding a simple test character to the level to test out the collision properties

tasks.title: Export Spritesheet from Piskel
tasks.description: Once you have created your pixel art character in Piskel you need to export it as a spritesheet to use in Godot. Important: choose the 'Export' option, then choose 'Spreitesheet file export'

tasks.title: Create AnimatedSprite2D
tasks.description: Create an AnimatedSprite2D node for your character and add the spritesheet you exported from Piskel as a SpriteFrames resource.

tasks.title: Modify Collision Shape
tasks.description: Modify the CollisionShape2D of your character to fit the new sprite
